purpose: Bootstrap template contains mcrcon RCON server installation and configuration for Minecraft server control.

expected.rendered_bootstrap:
# Install mcrcon for Minecraft server control.

# Create password file
cat > /etc/minecraft-mcrcon/password.conf << 'EOF'
mcrcon_password=${RCON_PASSWORD}
EOF

# Create service unit
cat > /etc/systemd/system/minecraft-mcrcon.socket << 'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=mcrcon RCON Socket
After=network.target

[Socket]
ListenStream=127.0.0.1:25577
NoDelay=true
KeepAlive=true

[Install]
WantedBy=sockets.target
EOF

cat > /etc/systemd/system/minecraft-mcrcon.service << 'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=mcrcon RCON Server for Minecraft
After=network.target
Requires=minecraft-restore.service
After=minecraft-restore.service

[Service]
Type=simple
User=minecraft
Group=minecraft
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/minecraft-mcrcon
EnvironmentFile=-/etc/default/mcrcon
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=10
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectSystem=full
ProtectHome=true
ReadWritePaths=/opt/minecraft/vanilla_no_grief

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF

systemctl daemon-reload
